purpose: Select whether and at what weight a high-spatial-band non-harm hinge should enter a later full-data training experiment.
claim_scope: exploratory direction/weight probe only; all 24 records were already consumed by v19 and cannot provide independent promotion evidence
truth_scope: train/final_train_confirm only; validation and test_id remain sealed
split: Within each family, sort the eight v19 sample IDs lexicographically; first six are fit and last two are holdout, yielding 18 fit and 6 holdout records.

plan.initialization: frozen v18 B_data_hinge best checkpoint for every arm
plan.optimizer: AdamW betas=(0.9,0.99), eps=1e-8, weight_decay=1e-4, grad clip=1.0, seed=372
plan.shared_loss: v18 masked_confined_loss + aggregate relative-error non-harm hinge lambda=1 margin=0.02
plan.spectral_training_metric: rfft2 high last-axis third, matching metric_record; 16 evenly spaced parent-retained future frames per update; candidate/parent high-band error ratio
plan.evaluation_metric: full-frame metric_record low/mid/high bands and early/mid/late time bands

readout.viable: Versus the frozen checkpoint baseline on the same six holdout records: high-band mean gain improves by at least +0.005, high-band nonworse count does not fall, aggregate mean gain drops by no more than 0.005, and worst aggregate harm is at least -0.02.
readout.selection: Among viable arms select the largest final high-band mean gain. If none is viable, do not carry a spectral hinge into full-data training.
